entries.title: Joshua 1:2
segments: When the servants of God die and enter into rest, those who survive should be aroused to increasing efforts to carry forward the good works which they had begun.

entries.title: Joshua 1:4
segments:
The wilderness; of Zin, on the south. 
 
  Lebanon; on the north. 
 
  Euphrates; on the east. 
 
  The great sea; the Mediterranean, on the west.

entries.title: Joshua 1:7
segments: The highest and noblest courage is shown by the most faithful discharge of duty, and no real coward makes it his great object to obey the known will of God.

entries.title: Joshua 1:8
segments: The grand means of inspiring and increasong true courage, is daily attention to the principles and precepts of the Bible, for the purpose of understanding and obeying them.

entries.title: Joshua 1:11
segments: The certainty that God will bestow upon his people the blessings he has promised them, does not in the least lessen the necessity of their using all appointed means to obtain them.

entries.title: Joshua 1:18
segments: Rebellion against rightful authority requiring what is right, is rebellion against God.
